definitions.explanation: Describing a material or substance that is physically hard, firm, and not easily deformed. Used as a technical or descriptive term for material properties.

examples.japanese: {硬質|こうしつ}なプラスチック。
この{小麦粉|こむぎこ}は{硬質|こうしつ}{小麦|こむぎ}から{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: This flour is made from hard wheat.

examples.japanese: {硬質|こうしつ}な{素材|そざい}で{作|つく}られたケースは{衝撃|しょうげき}に{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: Cases made from hard materials are resistant to impact.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a no-adjective ({硬質|こうしつ}な) or as a prefix in compounds. Common in product descriptions, material science, and food terminology ({硬質|こうしつ}{小麦|こむぎ} for durum wheat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {硬質|こうしつ}{小麦|こむぎ} (hard/durum wheat)
- {硬質|こうしつ}ゴム (hard rubber)
- {硬質|こうしつ}な{素材|そざい} (hard material)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {軟質|なんしつ}: soft, flexible — the opposite
- {硬|かた}い: hard — the everyday adjective for hardness
